categories.main_business_segments: Hanmi Semiconductor primarily operates in the semiconductor automation equipment manufacturing and sales sector. Its main product lines include micro SAW & Vision Placement equipment, Dual TC Bonder, Flip Chip Bonder, EMI Shield equipment, and other semiconductor manufacturing process equipment. The company also engages in export-import activities and real estate leasing as ancillary businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company develops and manufactures advanced semiconductor automation equipment using proprietary technologies, including micro SAW cutting modules, 2D/3D vision inspection systems, thermal compression bonding (Dual TC Bonder), flip-chip bonding, and EMI shielding technologies. It operates a vertically integrated production line encompassing design, manufacturing, assembly, inspection, and testing, supported by a dedicated R&D center with multiple test rooms and specialized saw modules.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hanmi Semiconductor serves leading global semiconductor manufacturers and packaging companies such as ASE, AmKor, Infineon, ST Micro, SK Hynix, Samsung Electronics, and others. Its products are critical in semiconductor packaging, memory chip production (notably High Bandwidth Memory for AI applications), automotive semiconductors, and emerging 6G communication device markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a strong presence in South Korea, China, Taiwan, Vietnam, and Southeast Asia. It maintains overseas subsidiaries and agents to support sales and customer relations in key semiconductor manufacturing regions, including North America, Asia, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hanmi Semiconductor operates primarily in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying semiconductor assembly and packaging equipment essential for chip production and testing processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D in micro SAW technology, thermal compression bonding for HBM chips, flip-chip bonding, and EMI shielding equipment to support AI, IoT, automotive, and 6G communication markets. It invests heavily in innovation, maintaining about 30% of its workforce in R&D, and collaborates with major customers like SK Hynix to co-develop cutting-edge equipment.
categories.revenue_model: Hanmi Semiconductor generates revenue primarily through the sale of customized semiconductor manufacturing equipment and related conversion kits. Sales are mostly order-based with pricing determined by raw material costs, customer specifications, and volume. The company also earns revenue from export-import activities and real estate leasing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hanmi Semiconductor holds a leading global market position, especially in micro SAW and vision placement equipment, maintaining the number one market share since the mid-2000s. It competes with other semiconductor equipment manufacturers but differentiates itself through proprietary technology, vertical integration, and strong customer relationships with major global semiconductor firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Hanmi Semiconductor reported consolidated revenues of approximately 159 billion KRW, with a net profit of 267 billion KRW, reflecting a significant decline from previous years due to global semiconductor market downturns. However, the company shows strong financial health with a 46.6% increase in equity and a 58.9% increase in total assets, supported by robust cash reserves and growing orders for HBM-related equipment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hanmi Semiconductor offers highly reliable, high-speed, and technologically advanced semiconductor automation equipment that integrates multiple process steps into single solutions. Its pioneering micro SAW technology, co-developed thermal compression bonding equipment for HBM chips, and EMI shielding solutions provide critical competitive advantages by enabling efficient, precise, and scalable semiconductor manufacturing tailored to emerging AI, automotive, and 6G markets.
